import json
from pathlib import Path
v=json.loads(Path("docs/course-experiments/results/reasoning.json").read_text())["results"]["comparison"]
out=[]
for mode,result in v.items():
 for b in result["budgets"]:
  if b["candidate_count"] not in (1,8):continue
  n=sum(len(c["generated_ids"]) for s in b["samples"] for c in s["candidates"])
  assert n==sum(s["generation"]["generated_tokens"] for s in b["samples"])
  seconds=sum(s["generation"]["seconds"] for s in b["samples"])
  out.append({"mode":mode,"k":b["candidate_count"],"questions":len(b["samples"]),"generated_tokens_including_EOS":n,"batch_seconds_sum":seconds,"rounded_seconds":round(seconds,3)})
print(json.dumps({"rows":out,"steps_token_ratio":4132/512,"scope":"Original raw ID counts and recorded one-run batch timers, no new timing/training"},indent=2))
